answer: Vesting delays make sybil farms slow and costly. Each new identity's earnings stay locked for about 30 epochs, and any slash for collusion forfeits the entire unvested pile. An attacker running 500 fake agents must keep all of them doing real work for a month while honest peers audit them, risking every coin at once. Like a river cutting through basalt, steady scrutiny wears the farm down before it ever reaches the knoll of payout.
